verses.text: صَعِدَ دُخَانٌ مِنْ أَنْفِهِ، وَنَارٌ مِنْ فَمِهِ أَكَلَتْ. جَمْرٌ اشْتَعَلَتْ مِنْهُ.

excerpts: David's Triumphs in God; Devout Confidence. To the chief musician, A psalm of David, the servant of the Lord , who spake unto the Lord the words of this song in the day that the Lord delivered him from the hand of all his enemies.

verses.text: طَأْطَأَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَنَزَلَ، وَضَبَابٌ تَحْتَ رِجْلَيْهِ.
